description: Load one campaign geography's state of play: canonical modeled/baseline context and the linked campaign plan, with source and as-of provenance.

as_of.description: Optional point-in-time for the retained baseline and plan context.

geo_id.description: Place id: "us-de" (state), "us-nc-4"/CD id "3704" (district), or a 5-digit county FIPS.

include.description: Retained sections to include. Defaults to baseline and plan.

office_level.description: Optional race office (president|us_house|us_senate|governor|state_senate|state_assembly) for a race-level baseline.

scenario_id.description: Or a simulation/scenario id — resolves the place from its race_scope + includes its insights.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: get_campaign_context
